problem: same finite time-expanded linear-cost multicommodity arc-flow LP as R1

splitting.local_variables: x[k,a]>=0 on allowed commodity arcs; B*x[k]=b[k] in vehicles
splitting.consensus_variables: z[k,a]>=0 on allowed arcs; sum_k z[k,a]<=capacity[a]
splitting.augmented_lagrangian: sum_k c^T x[k]+rho/2*||x-z+w||_2^2-rho/2*||w||_2^2, with local conservation and consensus capacity indicators
splitting.local_subproblem: min c^T x[k]+rho/2*||x[k]-(z[k]-w[k])||_2^2, x>=0, Bx=b, forbidden x=0
splitting.projection: z=EuclideanProjection_{z>=0,sum_k z<=u,forbidden=0}(x+w), independently for each arc
splitting.stopping: R1 absolute/relative primal and dual thresholds plus original-unit local conservation, capacity, projection, nonnegative, KKT and objective gates

scaling.row: for commodity demand d>0, divide each incidence equality and its right-hand side by d: B*(x/d)=b/d; right-hand side source +1, sink -1
scaling.variable: y=x/d and qbar=(z-w)/d; solve 0.5*||y||^2 + (c/(rho*d))^T y over By=b/d,y>=0
scaling.potential: h=p/(rho*d); dual objective 0.5*||y||^2+(b/d)^T h up to a constant; y=max(0,qbar-c/(rho*d)-B^T h)
scaling.inverse: x=d*y; p=rho*d*h; all public residuals, objective and gates recomputed from x,z,w in original units
scaling.rho_initial: clip(median strictly positive finite arc cost / median commodity volume, 0.0001, 1.0); deterministic from input only

local_solver.algorithm: L-BFGS-B on scaled dual, then damped active-set semismooth Newton and nonnegative active-support least-squares correction if needed
local_solver.warm_start: input-cost shortest-path node potentials initially; carry physical-unit potentials between iterations and convert using current rho*d; no reference data
local_solver.failure_rule: stop the case if original-unit conservation exceeds 1e-5; independent KKT gate on final state

variants.rho: every 10 completed outer iterations, if primal>10*dual multiply rho by 2; if dual>10*primal divide rho by 2; clip to [max(0.0001,rho_initial/16),min(16,rho_initial*16)]; rescale w by old/new

selection: Run R2_S in order. Select R2_S if every mandatory gate passes. Otherwise run R2_R in the same order and select only if every mandatory gate passes. Stop the ladder at a failed case for a variant. If neither passes, do not freeze or run Boston.
boston_holdout: Only after selected policy and source/evaluator hashes are frozen; same source and policy, no retuning; original-unit independent gates and same-graph LP comparison after run.
reference_boundary: Solver receives arc and demand CSV plus this policy only; reference objectives and flows are read solely by final evaluator after a run.
